share some updates on our operation and ongoing capex. 
 
For Q2 FY27, Shilchar Technologies reported revenue from operation of INR192.61 crores, up 
43% over Q1 FY27 and up 12% over Q2 FY26. EBITDA, excluding other income, stood at 
INR40.06 crores with an EBITDA margin of 20.8%. Profit after tax for the quarter stood at 
INR32.98 crores with a PAT margin of 16.5%. As you can see from the top line growth, business 
momentum picked up notably in Q2 after a slow start to the financial year in the Q1. 
 
As we discussed on our last call, Q1 performance was a result of continuing effect of the crisis 
in West Asia, which weighted on our exports. On the export front, conditions in the Middle East 
improved during the quarter, but they are yet to fully normalize. The higher shipping and logistic 
costs we highlighted in previous quarter have not eased much. 
 
At the same time, exports to North America have gained momentum following the resolution of 
the tariff-related challenges of earlier quarters. The pickup in North America export has helped 
offset part of the shortfall in dispatches to the Middle East. 
 
On the domestic front, demand has remained very strong throughout. On profitability, our 
EBITDA margin improved to 20.8% in Q2 from 16.4% in Q1. We expect conditions for export 
to improve further in the near future. This should translate directly into higher export share in 
our revenue mix and in turn, a further improvement in margin over the coming quarters. 
 
On the project front, expansion Phase 3, which will add 6,500 MVA of capacity is progressing 
as per plan, with commissioning expected in April '27. Civil foundation work, PEB erection and 
utility infrastructure work are in progress and all major production equipment has been ordered. 
This will take our total capacity to 14,000 MVA and drive the next leg of growth from FY28 
onwards.
